meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 处理频道接线时会先读数据库，把频道分成已接线、已配置未接线、未配置三类；接着询问平台 ID 和隔离方式，用 register/ncl 新增、迁移或修复接线，最后输出一份配置摘要。
howto.when: 当用户要管理频道接线、隔离级别或新增频道分组时接管；典型时机是刚新增频道后、搭建过程中，或单独想重新配置时。

say.text: 帮我把这个新 Slack 频道接到客服组，保持同一会话。
say.note: Claude 会让你确认频道 ID，再执行注册接线。

say.text: 给我看下现在频道和代理组的接线情况。
say.note: 读取数据库，按已接线/未接线等状态汇总。

say.text: 再给另一个 Telegram 群接一个新代理，做完全隔离。
say.note: 会先确认隔离意图，再给出配对码让你发进群。

howto.what_en: Claude inspects the DB, classifies channels as wired / configured-but-unwired / not configured, asks for the channel ID and isolation choice, then uses register or ncl to add, move or repair wirings and shows a config summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to manage channel wiring, isolation levels, or channel groups; typically right after a channel was added, during setup, or as a standalone reconfiguration.

say_en.text: Wire this new Slack channel to the support agent group and keep one shared conversation.
say_en.note: Claude asks for the Slack channel ID and runs registration.

say_en.text: Show me the current wiring between channels and agent groups.
say_en.note: It reads the database and outputs a wired/unwired summary.

say_en.text: Add another Telegram group for a new fully isolated agent.
say_en.note: It checks isolation intent, then gives you a pairing code to post in the group.
